rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: FireflyモデルをAWSのAmazon EC2 P5/P6インスタンスで学習
relations.text_en: Firefly models are trained on Amazon EC2 P5/P6 instances on AWS

source.label: Amazon/AWS の発表(Adobe and Amazon collaboration)
source.label_en: Amazon/AWS press release (Adobe and Amazon collaboration)
source.quote: trained on Amazon EC2 P5 and P6 instances—with data stored in S3 and FSx for Lustre

relations.text: 次世代のFireflyモデルとエージェント型ワークフローで戦略的提携
relations.text_en: Strategic partnership on next-generation Firefly models and agentic workflows

source.label: Adobe の発表
source.quote: Adobe and NVIDIA today announced a strategic partnership to accelerate AI-powered creation, production and personalization
source.note: 今後の協業の話で、その後さらに拡大されています。
source.note_en: A forward-looking collaboration that was expanded further.

relations.text: Googleの生成AI(Gemini・Veo・Imagen)をAdobe製品へ取り込む提携を拡大
relations.text_en: Expanded partnership to bring Google AI models (Gemini, Veo, Imagen) into Adobe products

source.label: Adobe の発表
source.quote: Adobe (Nasdaq:ADBE) and Google Cloud announced an expanded strategic partnership to deliver the next generation of AI-powered creative technologies
source.note: 一部の機能は提供時期が先です。
source.note_en: Some capabilities are not yet available.

relations.text: Adobe Experience CloudをMicrosoft Copilotに取り込む計画を発表
relations.text_en: Plans to bring Adobe Experience Cloud workflows into Microsoft Copilot

source.label: Microsoft ニュース(共同発表)
source.quote: Adobe (Nasdaq:ADBE) and Microsoft (Nasdaq:MSFT) announced plans to bring Adobe Experience Cloud workflows and insights to Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365

relations.text: IBMが年次報告で、戦略パートナーとしてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: IBM’s annual report lists Adobe among its strategic partners

source.label: IBM 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our strategic partners include: Adobe, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft, Oracle, Palo Alto Networks, Salesforce, Samsung Electronics and SAP, among others.
source.note: IBMは、パートナーが別の分野では競合になりうると記載しています。
source.note_en: IBM notes partners may also be competitors in some areas.

relations.text: Accenture SongとAdobeの技術で、エージェント型の顧客体験オーケストレーションの枠組みを共同開発
relations.text_en: Accenture Song co-developed an agentic experience orchestration framework powered by Adobe technology

source.label: Adobe の発表(Cannes Lions)
source.quote: Adobe and Accenture Song have co-developed a new agentic experience orchestration framework, powered by Adobe technology

relations.text: Adobeの技術を使ったAIエージェント型の運用モデルを発表
relations.text_en: Unveiling an AI Agentic Operating Model enterprise solution powered by Adobe technology

source.label: Adobe の発表(Cannes Lions)
source.quote: Omnicom is unveiling implementation architectures across automotive, pharmaceuticals, retail, and financial services of its AI Agentic Operating Model, a new enterprise solution powered by Adobe technology
source.note: 発表された内容で、規模は示されていません。
source.note_en: Described as being unveiled; scale not stated.

relations.text: Adobeのコンテンツ・データ・AI基盤を導入する広告会社の1社
relations.text_en: Among agency partners deploying Adobe content, data and AI platforms

source.label: Adobe の発表(Cannes Lions)
source.quote: Accenture, Omnicom, Stagwell’s Code and Theory and WPP are deploying Adobe's content, data and AI platforms to transform how global brands create, activate and measure customer experiences

relations.text: Adobe Firefly Foundryでメディア制作に取り組んでいるとAdobeが説明
relations.text_en: Adobe says The Home Depot is working with Adobe Firefly Foundry on media production

source.label: Adobe ブログ
source.quote: Brands including The Home Depot, HUMAIN and Walt Disney Imagineering are already working with Firefly Foundry

relations.text: Walt Disney ImagineeringがAdobe Firefly Foundryを利用しているとAdobeが説明
relations.text_en: Adobe says Walt Disney Imagineering is working with Adobe Firefly Foundry

source.label: Adobe ブログ
source.quote: Brands including The Home Depot, HUMAIN and Walt Disney Imagineering are already working with Firefly Foundry
source.note: 記載はDisneyの一部門(Walt Disney Imagineering)です。
source.note_en: The source names Walt Disney Imagineering, a Disney division.

relations.text: Autodeskが年次報告で、競合としてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: Autodesk’s annual report names Adobe as a competitor

source.label: ADSK 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our primary global competitors include Adobe Systems Incorporated, Bentley Systems, Inc., Dassault Systèmes S.A.

relations.text: Brazeが年次報告で、競合としてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: Braze’s annual report names Adobe as a competitor

source.label: BRZE 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: We face competition from software companies that offer marketing solutions, such as Adobe, Salesforce, Iterable, and Klaviyo.

relations.text: Dropboxが年次報告で、競合としてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: Dropbox’s annual report names Adobe as a competitor

source.label: DBX 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: compete in the cloud storage market with products offered by Microsoft, Amazon, Apple, Google, and Adobe

relations.text: DocuSignが年次報告で、競合としてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: DocuSign’s annual report names Adobe as a competitor

source.label: DOCU 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our primary global competitor for eSignature is currently Adobe, which offers an electronic signature solution known as Adobe Acrobat Sign.

relations.text: Getty Imagesが年次報告で、競合としてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: Getty Images’s annual report names Adobe as a competitor

source.label: GETY 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: our principal competitors for creative content include bundled offerings (e.g., Canva, Adobe)

relations.text: Klaviyoが年次報告で、競合としてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: Klaviyo’s annual report names Adobe as a competitor

source.label: KVYO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Large, consolidated marketing automation software providers, such as Adobe and Salesforce

relations.text: Oracleが年次報告で、競合としてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: Oracle’s annual report names Adobe as a competitor

source.label: ORCL 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: compete directly with certain offerings from some of the largest and most competitive companies in the world, including Adobe Systems Incorporated, Alphabet Inc.

relations.text: Shutterstockが年次報告で、競合としてAdobeを挙げている
relations.text_en: Shutterstock’s annual report names Adobe as a competitor

source.label: SSTK 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: websites focused on providing creative workflow tools such as Adobe, Canva, Picsart and Bending Spoons

relations.text: Adobe Fireflyが、提携先のモデルの1つとしてOpenAIのモデルを提供
relations.text_en: Adobe Firefly offers OpenAI models among its partner models

source.label: Adobe 2026年委任状説明書(DEF 14A)
source.quote: over 25 leading partner models, including Google, OpenAI, Black Forest Labs, Luma, Runway, Topaz Labs and ElevenLabs

relations.text: AdobeとFigmaは、2022年の合併契約を、規制当局の承認の見通しが立たないとして双方合意で解消
relations.text_en: Adobe and Figma mutually terminated their 2022 merger agreement because there was no clear path to regulatory approval

source.label: Figma 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On December 17, 2023, we mutually agreed with Adobe to terminate the Merger Agreement based on the joint assessment that there was no clear path to obtain the required regulatory approvals
source.note: 買収は成立していません。Adobeは2024年度に10億ドルの解消料を計上したと報告しています。
source.note_en: The acquisition was not completed; Adobe reports a $1B termination fee in fiscal 2024.

relations.text: 傘下のCode and Theoryが、Adobe CX Enterpriseを使ったスポーツ向けコンテンツ基盤を発表
relations.text_en: Stagwell’s agency Code and Theory is launching a Content Operating System for Sports powered by Adobe CX Enterprise

source.label: Adobe の発表(Cannes Lions)
source.quote: Stagwell agency Code and Theory is launching the Content Operating System for Sports
source.note: 関係はStagwell傘下のCode and Theoryを通じたものです。
source.note_en: The relationship is via Stagwell subsidiary Code and Theory.

relations.text: AdobeのAI機能を活用する代理店の1社としてPublicisを提携先エコシステムに掲載
relations.text_en: Adobe lists Publicis among agencies leveraging Adobe AI capabilities in its partner ecosystem

source.label: Adobe の発表(Adobe Summit)
source.quote: Agencies (dentsu, Havas, Omnicom, Publicis, Stagwell, WPP) and system integrators (Accenture, Capgemini, Cognizant, Deloitte Digital, EY, IBM, Infosys, PwC, TCS) are leveraging Adobe’s AI capabilities
source.note: 提携先の一覧への掲載で、契約条件は書かれていません。
source.note_en: A partner-ecosystem listing; no deal terms are stated.
